name: Chemical Engineering
overview: Chemical Engineering is an intriguing discipline that combines scientific knowledge with engineering principles to develop innovative solutions for various industries. It involves applying chemistry, physics, biology, and mathematics to transform raw materials into valuable products. The field encompasses thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, process design, materials science, and fluid mechanics, with applications spanning pharmaceuticals, energy, environmental protection, and biotechnology.
